data.hypothesis: The supplied valid 8x128x32 and 4x256x16 candidates have aggregate repeated means of 0.01587444 s and 0.01140523 s, respectively, but no per-size timings are available. This 8x64x32 variant tests whether a narrower column panel improves cache residency relative to 8x128x32 while retaining i-k-j accumulation and static row-tile ownership. The reduced working set may help at n=1024; extra column-tile loop overhead may instead hurt.

transformations: Replace fixed-size dispatch with generic positive-n GEMM and zero the complete output on every call.
Use unpacked 8-row, 32-K, 64-column tiles in row-K-column tile order, with a contiguous inner output-column loop and ascending K accumulation.
Assign static OpenMP work by disjoint 8-row tiles for n >= 256; clamp workers to 1..8 and use a serial path for smaller sizes or a single requested worker.
